Washing machine.question: The old federal standards applicable before January _____ did not restrict water consumption; there was no limit on how much unheated rinse water could be used

Washing machine.subject: Disaster Management
Washing machine.question: In North America, the _____ program compares and lists energy-efficient clothes washers
Washing machine.fact: After new mandatory federal standards were introduced, many US washers were manufactured to be more energy- and water-efficient than required by the federal standard, or even than required by the more-stringent Energy Star standard. In North America, the Energy Star program compares and lists energy-efficient clothes washers.
